items.question: How many Care subscriptions were cancelled each month in 2025?
items.sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS month_start
)
SELECT
  m.month_start AS month,
  COUNT(s.id) AS cancelled_subscriptions
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s
  ON (s.cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= m.month_start::timestamp
 AND (s.cancelled_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < (m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')::timestamp
GROUP BY m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start;
items.answer: Lumora Care subscription cancellations for each month of 2025 (UTC, based on cancelled_at) are shown below. Cancellations ran between 31 and 48 per month for most of the year, except September (80) and October (78), which were the peaks. January and December each had 31, the lowest counts in the year.

items.question: Compare net revenue in 2025 with 2024

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT region_code, CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 'q2' WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 'q3' END AS period FROM order_revenue WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), agg AS (SELECT region_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 'q2') AS q2_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 'q3') AS q3_orders FROM base GROUP BY region_code) SELECT region_code, q2_orders, q3_orders, q3_orders - q2_orders AS diff_orders, ROUND((q3_orders - q2_orders)::numeric / NULLIF(q2_orders, 0), 4) AS pct_change FROM agg ORDER BY region_code

items.question: For each first-order month in 2025, how many new customers were there and how many of them placed another order within 60 days?

  WHERE first_order_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND first_order_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
repeaters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN order_revenue o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.ordered_at > c.first_order_at
    AND o.ordered_at <= c.first_order_at + INTERVAL '60 days'

  ROUND(COUNT(r.customer_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS repeat_rate_60d

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
